verdict.rationale: Poke is an AI assistant that processes user emails, calendars, and messages, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documented training-data opt-out or data-use policy. The only related item is disconnecting integrations, which is an adjacent control and is not credited.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
